subject: Re: train tickets
text: Yes, let’s swap the priorities since the venue move changed our timing. I’ll book the 08:40 departure instead of the earlier train because it gives us a safer transfer after setup. You should cancel the afternoon return and get a refundable one for Saturday. If the ticket system asks why, choose reschedule only. Send me the booking reference when it is done, and I’ll put both names on the shared trip folder. We also need one portable charger, not two, because I still have mine. Please keep the receipts too for expenses.
